title: Allow keyboard shortcut to trigger the new search field in the global menu on wayland
line: A new "Search Application Menu" global shortcut opens the Global Menu's search with the cursor already in the field.
explanation: The Global Menu's Search entry (Wayland only) is the last button of the menu bar. The widget's own shortcut opens the first menu, so getting to the search field from the keyboard meant opening File and pressing Right through every menu. The applet now registers one plasmashell global shortcut, "Search Application Menu" (no default key, set in System Settings > Shortcuts > Plasma Workspace), which opens the Search popup of the Global Menu that currently shows a menu; the field already gets focus when shown, so you can type right away.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: add a global shortcut to search the menu

The menu search could only be reached by clicking it or by opening a menu
with the widget shortcut and moving through every menu to the last one.
Add a "Search Application Menu" shortcut that opens it directly.

BUG: 439273

media.caption: Only the widget shortcut exists: it opens File, Search is eight menus to the right
The new Search Application Menu shortcut (Meta+Alt+F here) opens Search with the cursor in the field
Typing right after the shortcut filters Konsole's menu actions
